title: Source registry for the reference corpus
note: Every reference record names one or more of these sources. Tier follows the VetBuddy authority hierarchy: 1 statute/CFR/court, 2 federal or state agency, 3 accredited VSO or recognized nonprofit, 4 secondary compilation, news, research report. A tier-4 source may locate a lead; it may never be the sole basis of an eligibility conclusion. Internal governance documents carry tier null because they govern the build and assert no external fact.

records.title: VetBuddy Resource Database: Support Resources for Women Veterans Across All 50 States
records.note: Compiles VA, state-agency and nonprofit pages. Staff names and emails are volatile; this corpus keeps office-level contacts only.

records.title: Military-to-Civilian Transition Finances: A Data-Driven Roadmap for VetBuddy
records.note: Rates are FY2025 by design; its own caveats name the 2026 changes. Rule-of-thumb multipliers are not DoD-published.
